description:
Generate voice block audio. Every speaker needs a voice first, and
every asset a reference image. Without voice_block_ids it fills every
block with no audio, skipping ones already generating. A model must
match the project's voice engine. An existing storyboard retimes to the
new audio on its own.

dry_run.description: Return the count and credit estimate; start nothing

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id

model.description: Model id (get_generation_options); omit for the saved choice

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

voice_block_ids.description: Blocks to generate, again if they have audio; omit for every block without audio

name: voiceover_generate
title: Generate the voiceover
